interested_next_step.subject: Next steps for the GLP Clinic Scout sponsor pilot
interested_next_step.body:
Hi {organization} team,

Thanks for your interest. The pilot is $750 for setup and 30 days: one Sponsored directory panel, one sponsor introduction page and a delivery report. An optional same scope 30 day renewal is $500, only if you choose it. There is no automatic renewal or charge.

Please reply with your preferred start date, legal business name, billing contact, proposed destination URL and permission to use your brand name and supplied wording. Include any affiliate program restrictions. Please do not send patient or other sensitive information.

We'll confirm availability, the exact wording, permissions and dates before issuing a PayPal invoice. Placement starts only after payment is confirmed and the agreed asset is ready. Sponsorship does not change our independent rankings. We cannot guarantee impressions, traffic, leads or sales. Nothing is booked or payable yet.
